objective: Maintain LevelUpDiag-MediKristal as a target-specific, non-clinical validation suite for MediKristal 0.2.0 and later explicitly profiled versions.
invariants: Prefer MediKristal canonical validators before duplicating their logic.
Keep the target read-only by default; run mutating generators in a disposable copy.
Keep software, documentary, packaging, provenance and deployment evidence distinct.
Do not accept required SKIP, BLOCKED or PARTIAL as PASS.
Do not advertise unconfigured external capabilities as successful.
Do not infer clinical, regulatory, PostgreSQL, Docker or partner qualification from local synthetic tests.
Use stable finding IDs and bounded/redacted evidence.
Treat documented counts and generated evidence as claims to remeasure, not as authorities about themselves.
